reason: A document-processing plugin that sends PDFs and images to PaddleOCR-VL, tracks asynchronous parsing jobs, and exports layout-aware Markdown with extracted images.

summaries.zh: 通过 PaddleOCR-VL 解析 PDF 和图片的文档布局，支持异步任务进度跟踪，并将结果导出为 Markdown 和图片文件。
summaries.en: Process PDF and image document layouts with PaddleOCR-VL, track asynchronous jobs, and export results as Markdown with extracted images.

capabilities: Sends PDF and image files to the PaddleOCR external API for layout parsing
Creates Markdown files and extracted image files in a specified output directory
Runs asynchronous OCR jobs with polling, progress tracking, retries, and queue handling
Provides a browser settings card and task panel for file submission and result export
Uses an API token supplied through plugin settings or the PADDLE_OCR_TOKEN environment variable
Splits oversized PDFs into smaller parts before processing
